verdict.rationale: A performance mode toggle is a fair hardware-support question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a performance, high-power or energy mode that boosts hardware performance on demand. The docs cover Continuity, Siri AI, Safari and window management, and the community items cover unrelated bugs and CLI tips.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can boost hardware performance on demand using a performance mode toggle
